title: The Shy Ghost
text: A small ghost follows the party at a distance, a pale shape no bigger than a child, ducking behind trees whenever anyone looks. At night it comes closer. It seems more afraid of some of you than others.

options.label: The one who has hurt the fewest goes to it, gently, so it does not flee.

outcomes.text: It comes close and gives them something it was keeping. Then it is gone.

options.label: The quickest chases it down to learn what it wants.

outcomes.text: It bursts into cold light, and the cold gets into everyone's joints.
It flees into a cave, showing you a way through.

options.label: Let it follow; it means no harm, or not yet.

outcomes.text: It follows for a while, then is gone. In the morning everyone's boots have been cleaned and their buckles mended.
